summary.en: Compare a darker cabinet front with a stone-look alternative.
summary.zh: 在深色与石纹外观之间比较浴室搭配。

description.en:
Wall-mounted vanity arrangements are shown in dark and stone-look appearances, with both closed and open storage views. Use the images to discuss the cabinet front, basin and mirror combination you need.
Confirm cabinet materials, water-exposure requirements, fittings and installation details for the selected configuration.
description.zh:
悬挂式浴室柜提供深色及石纹外观，并展示封闭与打开的收纳效果，可围绕柜体、盆体和镜面组合沟通选型。
请按所选配置确认柜体材料、接触水条件、五金及安装细节。

en: Basin, mirror and storage fittings confirmed with the model.
zh: 配有深色及石纹柜体正面示例。
盆体、镜面及收纳五金按款式确认。
